name: I SUPPOSE
source:
A story of a simple walk home, with a sprinkling of intrusive thoughts. Make a few choices, decide what's best, and please, try not to overthink.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3086910/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个简单的步行回家的故事，其中夹杂着一些侵入性的想法。做出一些选择，决定什么是最好的，并且请尽量不要想太多。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3086910/]Steam[/url]]
